flows.name: Fortress Current Issue
flows.description: Spectacular Settlements, Fortresses, General: a Ruin or Bare Bones fortress first has structural damage (1d6), then the Current Issue roll; each issue but Peaceful rolls its severity.

flows.name: Keep Rooms
flows.description: Spectacular Settlements, Fortresses, Keep: the starting rooms (Bedroom, Kitchen, Dining and Receiving, and Guard Bunks with a Large or Maximum garrison), the free Privy, the number of rooms (BSM x floors, the cellar counting, modified by Condition, starting rooms included), then a Rooms roll for each room left.

steps.name: Starting: Guard Bunks (Large or Maximum garrison)

flows.name: Curtain Wall Towers
flows.description: Spectacular Settlements, Fortresses, Castle: the towers along the wall (castle BSM + 1d4), each rolling its shape, size and roof.

flows.name: Curtain Wall Defenses
flows.description: Spectacular Settlements, Fortresses, Castle: Curtain Wall Defenses rolls by Expense (Paltry 0, Modest 1, Moderate 2, Significant 3, Extravagant 4).

flows.name: Bailey Outbuildings
flows.description: Spectacular Settlements, Fortresses, Castle: castle BSM + 1 bailey outbuildings, each rolling its size.

flows.name: Additional Curtain Wall Towers
flows.description: Spectacular Settlements, Fortresses, Stronghold: +1d8 towers to the castle's curtain wall towers, each rolling its shape, size and roof.
